# SOT — Stash Or Trash | The Brand Barometer

> SOT (Stash Or Trash) is a modern Consumer Experience (CX) & Public Relations (PR) platform where real customers deliver live verdicts on brand experiences.

## Core Services & Features
- **Brand Barometer**: Real-time crowd-sourced customer trust scores and ratings across verified retail, hospitality, tech, and FMCG brands.
- **Stash vs Trash Verdicts**: Users vote "Stash" (commendation) or "Trash" (constructive criticism) based on verified real-world product and service experiences.
- **Anti-Counterfeit & Packaging Scanner**: AI-assisted barcode, luxury logo, and optical inspection verifying product authenticity and tracing parent company ownership.
- **Brand Suite & Resolution Desk**: Direct brand-to-consumer communication channels, allowing verified corporate teams to resolve issues, turnaround complaints, and build consumer trust.
- **Awards & Milestones**: Monthly and annual recognition for top-performing brands maintaining high customer trust factors.

## Key Public Routes
- Homepage: https://stash-or-trash-hub.vercel.app/
- Live Verdict Feed: https://stash-or-trash-hub.vercel.app/feed
- Verified Brand Directory: https://stash-or-trash-hub.vercel.app/brands
- AI Authenticity & Barcode Scanner: https://stash-or-trash-hub.vercel.app/scan
- Brand Barometer Awards: https://stash-or-trash-hub.vercel.app/awards

## Entity Structure
- Organization Name: Stash Or Trash (SOT)
- Primary Purpose: CX/PR Brand Barometer & Consumer Accountability Platform
- Supported Locales: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Zulu, Xhosa, Sesotho
